ns2:course.label: Advanced Choral Conducting I
ns2:course.description: Laboratory/practicum course for review and development of choral conducting skills and their integration into the student's full complement of teaching skills and knowledge. Score analysis and preparation lead to the application of teaching and rehearsal skills. Prerequisite: Music education majors; MUS 242; concurrent registration in MUS 348 is required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Music education majors; MUS 242; concurrent registration in MUS 348 is required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Technology -UIUC, or MME:Music Education -UIUC.
